description: I had the opportunity to join my colleagues this weekend at the Democratic Caucus retreat at Sandia Resort and Casino. It was a valuable time to connect, share ideas, and prepare for the important work ahead on behalf of New Mexicans. Later in the evening, I attended the Speaker’s fundraiser dinner
paid_for_by: authorized by Doreen Gallegos for HD52
title: Democratic Conference Retreat Brings Leaders Together — Doreen Ybarra Gallegos - NM State Representative District 52
